question: Padma Shri awardees in 2022, known for their great performances of the dance style of Kathak, sister duo Kamalini Asthana and Nalini Asthana belong to which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kamalini Asthana and Nalini Asthana**, sister duo, are renowned for their contributions to the **Kathak dance form**.
 
• They were awarded the **Padma Shri** in 2022 for their exceptional performances and dedication to preserving Indian classical dance.
 
• The sisters hail from the state of **Uttar Pradesh**, which has a rich tradition in Kathak.
 
• **Kathak** is one of the eight classical dance forms of India and is deeply rooted in the cultural heritage of northern India, including Uttar Pradesh.
 
• Their work emphasizes **traditional storytelling** through dance, blending rhythmic footwork, graceful movements, and intricate expressions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kathak**:

 
 
• Kathak is an ancient Indian classical dance form known for its storytelling aspects, deriving its name from the Sanskrit word **"Katha"**, meaning story.
 
• It is characterized by **fast footwork**, spins, and intricate gestures, accompanied by classical Hindustani music.
 
 
 
• **Padma Shri Award**:
 
 
• Padma Shri is the fourth highest civilian award in India, presented for distinguished contributions in various fields like arts, education, literature, sports, and social work.
 
• It is announced annually on **Republic Day** by the Government of India.
 
 
 
• **Role of Uttar Pradesh in Kathak**:
 
 
• Uttar Pradesh is considered the **birthplace of Kathak**, especially the Lucknow Gharana, which is renowned for its focus on expressions and storytelling.
 
• Lucknow and Varanasi have historically been centers for the development and preservation of Kathak traditions.
 
 
 
• **Other Padma Shri Awardees (Dance in 2022)**:
 
 
• Other prominent dancers who received the Padma Shri in 2022 include **Dr. Sonal Mansingh** (Odissi) and **Ramli Ibrahim** (Bharatanatyam).
